parameters.query:
SELECT i.id, i.diagnosis_json, i.workflow_name, i.node_name, i.error_message, i.severity,
       a.name AS approver_name, a.permission_level,
       (a.permission_level = 'full' OR (a.permission_level = 'partial' AND i.severity = 'low')) AS can_approve
FROM approval_tokens t
JOIN approvers a ON a.id = t.approver_id AND a.active
JOIN incidents i ON i.id = t.incident_id
WHERE t.incident_id::text = $1
  AND t.token_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to($2,'UTF8')),'hex')
  AND t.used_at IS NULL
  AND t.expires_at > now()
  AND i.status = 'awaiting_approval'
  AND i.decided_by IS NULL
LIMIT 1;

parameters.responseBody:
⚠️ Invalid or Expired Link

This approval link is no longer valid. It may have expired (48h) or already been used.

parameters.content:
REVIEW PAGE (GET only — never changes state): validates the token
(matches, not expired, still awaiting_approval) against the DB, purely
read-only. Immune to email/link-scanner prefetch auto-approving things.

True path: builds the HTML page from the approved diagnosis (root
cause, proposed fix) with two <form> buttons that POST to W2b's
/heal-decide webhook, carrying incident+token+action as hidden fields.

False path: token invalid, expired, or already used — shows a
simple "link no longer valid" page instead.
